Question: Aslamalaikum Rahmatull, This is Mohd Raoof live in saudia Arabia my question is iam from Hanafi Maslak can i Perform namaz other maslak like Shafi,Hambal,Malik or i can offer namaz seprately plz give me the answer. Answer ID: 14352 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1092/1092=M/1430) Performing salah behind an imam of other maslak is permissible if the imam cares for the Hanafi Maslak in regard to the fardh and wajib acts. For example, he makes wudhu after occurring the things which invalidate wudhu according to Hanafi Fiqh like blood etc. If it is known certainly that the imam does not care for the same, so one should not perform salah behind him: أما الاقتداء بالمخالف في الفروع کالشافعي فیجوز ما لم یعلم منہ ما یفسد الصلاۃ علی اعتقاد المقتدي، علیہ الإجماع (الشامي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
